name: hardcharger.graceful_shutdown
description: On the first stop signal, let running statements finish (false: stop at once). Takes effect at the next signal.

name: hardcharger.max_concurrent_statements
description: Statements that run at once; more wait in the queue (0: no queue).

name: hardcharger.max_queued_statements
description: Statements that may wait for a slot (-1: 8 x max_concurrent_statements; 0: unbounded).

name: hardcharger.shutdown_grace_period_seconds
description: How long a graceful shutdown waits for running statements (0: forever); also during a shutdown.

name: hardcharger.bypass_queue
description: Skip the statement queue for this session (admins only may turn it on).

name: hardcharger.query_tag
description: JSON object tagging this session's statements in instrumentation.

name: hardcharger.session_tag
description: JSON object tagging this session in instrumentation.

name: hardcharger.capture_query_profile
description: Record DuckDB's query profile with each execution in instrumentation (off, standard, detailed).

name: hardcharger.idle_in_transaction_session_timeout
description: Seconds a session may hold a transaction open with nothing running and no request before it is ended and the transaction rolled back (0: never), as PostgreSQL's setting of the same name. SESSION sets this session's; GLOBAL every session that hasn't set its own.

name: hardcharger.max_queue_wait
description: Seconds a statement may wait in the queue (0: forever).

name: hardcharger.query_log_level
description: Level of statement log lines (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

name: hardcharger.query_timeout
description: Statement timeout in seconds (0: none). A request's Chargewire-Statement-Timeout wins.

name: hardcharger.admin_bypass_queue_default
description: Admin sessions skip the statement queue by default.

name: hardcharger.allow_unsigned_extensions
description: DuckDB may load unsigned extensions.

name: hardcharger.auth_log_level
description: Level of sign-in log lines.

name: hardcharger.block_sensitive_paths
description: Protect credential and system files from SQL file access.

name: hardcharger.block_unredacted_secrets
description: Refuse attempts to enable unredacted secret output.

name: hardcharger.cluster_id
description: UUID shared by the replicas of one cluster (empty when unset).

name: hardcharger.default_catalog
description: Configured starting catalog for new sessions (empty: inherit the startup SQL/database context).

name: hardcharger.default_schema
description: Configured starting schema for new sessions (empty: use the selected catalog's default schema).

name: hardcharger.enable_catalog_logging
description: Log lines are also written to a logs table.

name: hardcharger.enable_instrumentation
description: Sessions, statements and executions are recorded.

name: hardcharger.enable_metrics
description: Runtime metrics are collected and served (/metrics, hardcharger_metrics()).

name: hardcharger.health_check_interval_seconds
description: Seconds between background health checks.

name: hardcharger.health_check_staleness_seconds
description: Age at which the last health check no longer counts.

name: hardcharger.health_port
description: Configured plaintext health listener port (0: none).

name: hardcharger.host
description: Configured client listener address.

name: hardcharger.instance_id
description: This server process's UUID (as HARDCHARGER_CURRENT_INSTANCE()).

name: hardcharger.instance_tag
description: JSON object recorded with this instance.

name: hardcharger.instrumentation_catalog
description: Catalog of the instrumentation tables (empty when instrumentation is off).

name: hardcharger.instrumentation_schema
description: Schema of the instrumentation tables (empty when instrumentation is off).

name: hardcharger.log_catalog
description: Catalog of the logs table (empty when catalog logging is off).

name: hardcharger.log_schema
description: Schema of the logs table (empty when catalog logging is off).

name: hardcharger.max_header_bytes
description: Largest request header block accepted, in bytes.

name: hardcharger.max_ingest_message_bytes
description: Maximum wire bytes per Arrow ingest message and total expanded buffer bytes per batch.

name: hardcharger.max_result_partitions
description: Maximum result partitions offered to a client (1: never split).

name: hardcharger.max_sessions
description: Most non-admin sessions at once; more get too_many_sessions (0: unlimited).

name: hardcharger.memory_limit
description: DuckDB memory_limit (empty: DuckDB's default).

name: hardcharger.metrics_bind_address
description: Configured metrics listener address; requires enable_metrics.

name: hardcharger.metrics_port
description: Configured metrics HTTP port (0: no endpoint; requires enable_metrics).

name: hardcharger.port
description: Configured client listener port.

name: hardcharger.read_only
description: Database opened read-only: every write is refused.

name: hardcharger.result_batch_rows
description: Rows per Arrow result batch.

name: hardcharger.result_retention_seconds
description: Seconds a retained result remains readable after statement completion.

name: hardcharger.session_idle_timeout
description: Seconds an idle session lives (0: forever).

name: hardcharger.session_log_level
description: Level of session log lines.

name: hardcharger.storage_version
description: DuckDB storage version for new databases (empty: DuckDB's default).

name: hardcharger.version
description: Server version (as HARDCHARGER_VERSION()).

name: hardcharger.web_ui
description: Serve the embedded Web UI on the client listener.

name: hardcharger.web_ui_remote_servers
description: Allow Web UI connections to other servers through this server's relay.
